fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI pense qu'en excluant les juges suppléants de l'élection, on abaissera l'importance de leur rôle.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI pointed out that by excluding deputy-judges from the election, the importance of their position would be lessened.
